notes.title: Resolve the mux issue and review wiring
notes.body: The isolated-board resistance reports make the mux suspect; replacement is a practical option. Review actual sensor and strip connections before powered testing.

notes.title: Eight sensors and provisional cable lengths
notes.body: One-end, equal-spacing model totals about 75 ft of four-conductor sensor cable including service allowance and 15% spare. Controller placement, routes and long I²C reliability remain unconfirmed.

notes.title: Lights under the handrail, sensors at baseboard
notes.body: CQRobot PCB is 28.5 × 23 mm. Candidate enclosure external dimensions are 60 × 36 × 17 mm; connector fit and optical opening remain unverified.

notes.title: Historical source is not current hardware evidence
notes.body: One sensor and 90 LEDs worked historically. Saved 800/950 mm thresholds are not maximum range or verified current settings. Interference diagnostic compiled, not uploaded; about 80 LEDs estimated.
